ecb-2026-09.standing: The European Central Bank's Governing Council, which sets the policy rates for the euro area on a fixed schedule through the year. Its decisions set the cost of credit across the currency bloc and transmit to bond yields and the euro's exchange rate.

fomc-2026-09.standing: The Federal Reserve's rate-setting committee, which meets eight times a year to set the target range for overnight bank lending. Its decisions move the cost of borrowing across the dollar economy and every asset priced against the dollar.
fomc-2026-09.recent: Minutes released in August showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, and bond yields surged as traders shifted attention from CPI to the Fed's next tests. The dollar fell against the euro as markets trimmed rate hike bets, leaving this meeting to settle which of those two readings the committee endorses.

boe-2026-09.standing: The United Kingdom's central bank, whose Monetary Policy Committee meets eight times a year to set Bank Rate. That rate sets the floor for British borrowing costs, feeding through to mortgages, business lending and the pound.
boe-2026-09.recent: The committee meets against a run of central banks turning hawkish: Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, RBI minutes indicated a hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady while flagging another hike is still possible. The Bank has also been expanding its digital pound pilot with Polygon and stablecoins.

boj-2026-09.standing: Japan's central bank sets short-term policy rates and guides government bond yields at scheduled meetings through the year. Its decisions move the yen, Japanese government bond yields, and the global carry trades funded in cheap yen.
boj-2026-09.recent: The meeting comes as other central banks lean hawkish: Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, RBI's MPC minutes indicated a hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady while flagging another hike is still possible. The dollar has already fallen against the euro as markets trim rate hike bets.

uk-cpi-2026-10.standing: The Office for National Statistics' monthly measure of UK consumer price inflation, published for the preceding month. It is the reference rate for the Bank of England's 2% target, and it sets the uprating of pensions, benefits and index-linked gilts.

fomc-2026-10.standing: The Federal Reserve's rate-setting committee, which meets eight times a year to set the target range for overnight bank lending. Its decisions set the cost of borrowing across the dollar economy and reprice assets worldwide.
fomc-2026-10.recent: Minutes released this month showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, and bond yields surged as traders turned from CPI to the Fed's next tests. The dollar fell against the euro as markets trimmed rate hike bets, while gold hit $4,392 an ounce. This meeting settles which of those two readings the committee acts on.

ecb-2026-10.standing: The European Central Bank's Governing Council decision on interest rates for the euro area, taken at scheduled meetings through the year. It sets the deposit rate that anchors borrowing costs across the currency bloc and feeds through to the euro's exchange rate.
ecb-2026-10.recent: The meeting comes as major central banks pull in different directions: Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, the RBI's MPC minutes indicated a hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady as its housing market softened. The decision will settle where the euro area sits against that turn.

boj-2026-10.standing: Japan's central bank, whose policy board sets the country's short-term interest rate and the shape of its bond purchases. Its decisions move the yen, Japanese government bond yields, and the global carry trades funded in cheap yen.
boj-2026-10.recent: The meeting comes as major central banks tilt toward tighter policy: Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, the RBI's MPC minutes indicated hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady while flagging another hike is still possible. The dollar has already fallen against the euro as markets trim rate hike bets.

fred-us-gdp-2026-08-26.standing: The Bureau of Economic Analysis's quarterly estimate of US economic output, released in successive revisions as more source data arrives. It is the broadest single measure of American demand, and sets the frame for rate expectations and dollar pricing worldwide.
fred-us-gdp-2026-08-26.recent: The release lands with the world's other large economies visibly slowing: China's retail sales rose just 0.6% in July, and Russia reported annualized GDP growth of 0.6% in the first half. The dollar has already fallen against the euro as markets trimmed rate hike bets, leaving this print to settle how much of the slowdown reaches US demand.

fred-us-pce-2026-08-26.standing: The Bureau of Economic Analysis's monthly report on personal consumption expenditures, covering household income, spending and the price index the Federal Reserve uses as its official inflation gauge.

g20-2026-miami.standing: The annual meeting of leaders from the world's twenty largest economies, rotating through a presidency that sets the agenda. It has no treaty power, but its communiqués steer coordination on trade, debt relief and financial regulation.
g20-2026-miami.recent: This summit falls under the US presidency, which sets what leaders take up. It follows a year in which the multilateral calendar carried its own weight: 196 countries convened in Ulaanbaatar on desertification and drought, and all 193 UN states met in Geneva on AI rules. Whether either reaches the leaders' table is what December settles.

ecb-2026-12.standing: The European Central Bank's governing council sets interest rates for the euro area, meeting roughly every six weeks. Its decisions set the cost of borrowing across twenty member economies and anchor the euro against every currency it trades with.
ecb-2026-12.recent: The decision closes a year in which several major central banks turned back toward tightening. Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, the RBI's MPC minutes indicated a hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady while flagging another hike is still possible. This meeting settles where the euro area stands against that shift.

boe-2026-12.standing: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee, which votes on the UK's Bank Rate and sets the price of sterling credit. Its decisions transmit to British mortgages, gilt yields and the pound.
boe-2026-12.recent: The committee's December vote lands with inflation still the live question across major central banks: Fed minutes showed many officials said rate hikes may be needed, RBI's MPC minutes indicated a hardening of interest rates, and the RBA held steady while flagging another hike is still possible. Separately, the Bank is expanding its digital pound pilot with Polygon and stablecoins.

boj-2026-12.standing: Japan's central bank sets the country's short-term policy rate at scheduled meetings through the year. Its decisions move the yen, Japanese government bond yields, and the global carry trades funded in cheap yen.
